theme: NMDA receptor calcium signalling in synaptic plasticity
core_role: The shared pathways are the Ca2+-activated CaMKK/CaMKIV/CaMKII and AMPK kinase relays that turn NMDA-receptor calcium influx into CREB phosphorylation and energy sensing, i.e. the nuclear, transcriptional output arm of glutamatergic long-term potentiation.

theme: Protein quality control via proteasomal and autophagic degradation
core_role: The shared pathways are the proteasome and ubiquitin/degron-dependent degradation machinery (with ERAD control, deubiquitinases and chaperone folding) that forms the proteasomal arm of clearing misfolded or unstable proteins, complementing the aggrephagy and autophagy routes.

theme: Specialized pro-resolving lipid mediator biosynthesis
core_role: The shared pathways are the lipoxygenase-driven oxygenation of arachidonate and omega-3 PUFAs (lipoxins, 5-/15-HETE derivatives, electrophilic oxo-derivatives, maresin/protectin/resolvin conjugates), framed as precursor branches of the mediators that resolve inflammation and promote tissue regeneration.

theme: SLC transporter-mediated epithelial nutrient transport and its disorders
core_role: The shared pathways are the carbohydrate arm of epithelial solute handling, covering dietary sugar digestion, intestinal and renal hexose uptake and the SGLT/GLUT defect disorders, alongside the amino acid, urate and organic anion carriers.

theme: Regulation of TGF-beta receptor and SMAD signalling
core_role: The shared pathways describe betaglycan (TGFBR3) as a co-receptor that presents or sequesters ligands for TGF-beta and FGF2 receptors, so they act as an upstream modulator setting the strength of SMAD signalling.

theme: Regulation of mitochondrial respiration and oxidative stress
core_role: The shared pathways are direct control of oxidative phosphorylation, electron transport, ATP synthesis and ROS output, framed as the bioenergetic set point that governs cellular stress responses to hypoxia, drugs and apoptotic cues.

theme: IL-12 and IFN-gamma driven Th1 immunity
core_role: The shared pathways are antigen presentation and IL-12/JAK-STAT signalling, serving as the antigen-presenting-cell-to-T-cell priming inputs that drive Th1 differentiation and IFN-gamma-regulated MHC expression.

theme: Netrin-mediated axon guidance
core_role: The shared pathways are the growth-cone behaviours of axon extension, chemorepulsion and collateral sprouting, framed as the guidance outcomes that netrin signalling and its second messengers steer.

theme: Mucosal innate antibacterial defence
core_role: The shared pathways are host antimicrobial effector mechanisms at epithelial surfaces (bacterial agglutination, metal sequestration, killing of Gram-positive bacteria, control of bacterial attachment and entry), framed as defence against invasive bacteria such as Listeria.

theme: Chromatin assembly and ATP-dependent chromatin remodelling
core_role: The shared pathways are replication-coupled nucleosome deposition and organization, the chromatin packaging substrate that BAF and CHD remodelling complexes reorganize during replication, repair and stem cell maintenance.

theme: Dendritic cell-driven Th1 immune activation
core_role: The shared pathways are the cytokine outputs (IL-12, IFN-gamma, GM-CSF) produced by activated dendritic cells and T cells, framed as the signals that polarize T cells towards a Th1 response.

theme: Dopaminergic neurotransmission and psychostimulant response
core_role: The shared pathways are catecholamine synthesis and presynaptic reuptake by DAT/NET transporters, framed as the control of synaptic dopamine levels that sets receptor signalling and is the target of cocaine and amphetamine.

theme: Dendritic cell innate activation and Th1 priming
core_role: The shared pathways are innate sensing and dendritic cell cytokine and chemokine production (cGAS-STING, response to protozoa, CCL5, STAT6 chemokines), framed as the trigger that leads to IL-12 and IFN-gamma driven Th1 responses.

theme: N-glycan processing and amino sugar/mannose metabolism
core_role: The shared pathways are glycosidase-mediated N-glycan trimming in the ER and lysosomal oligosaccharide breakdown (with their CDG/MRT defects), framed as glycan processing and turnover that feeds monosaccharide metabolism.

theme: Nuclear RNA processing: 3'-end formation, splicing and decay
core_role: The shared pathways are pre-mRNA 3'-end cleavage and polyadenylation, histone stem-loop processing and Pol II termination, forming the 3'-end maturation step within the broader nuclear splicing, snRNA and RNA surveillance machinery.

theme: Peroxisomal and mitochondrial fatty acid oxidation
core_role: The shared pathways are generic organic acid metabolism and peroxisomal beta-oxidation of branched-chain pristanoyl-CoA, framed as the shared peroxisome-mitochondria fatty acid catabolism route that handles very-long, branched and medium chains.

theme: Glutamate and glutamine nitrogen metabolism
core_role: The shared pathways are glutamate, glutamine and aspartate interconversions and ammonium handling, framed as cellular nitrogen assimilation and disposal coupled to the malate-aspartate shuttle.

theme: Golgi-endosome membrane trafficking
core_role: The shared pathways are the cargo routes between plasma membrane, Golgi and endosomes (endocytosis, constitutive secretion, receptor recycling, Golgi targeting), framed as the trafficking outputs carried out by membrane budding and tubulation machinery.

theme: Planar cell polarity and convergent extension in axis formation
core_role: The shared pathways are notochord and axial mesoderm morphogenesis, apical constriction and dampening of canonical Wnt/TCF signalling, framed as the tissue-shaping outcomes driven by non-canonical Wnt/PCP and Hedgehog signalling.

theme: Histone modification and chromatin remodelling
core_role: The shared pathways are histone lysine methylation and demethylation plus CHD1/2 remodellers, framed as writers, erasers and remodellers setting epigenetic chromatin state alongside NuRD, HDACs and KMT complexes.

theme: Oncogenic receptor tyrosine kinase fusions in cancer
core_role: The shared pathways are FGFR1/2/3 fusion signalling, presented as one family of constitutively active RTK fusion drivers alongside PDGFR, LTK and ALK oncogenic kinases.

theme: Transition metal ion homeostasis
core_role: The shared pathways are copper and manganese import, transport, detoxification and ceruloplasmin function, framed as one part of broader transition metal handling that includes iron export and cobalt transport.

theme: NAD+ metabolism from tryptophan and niacin
core_role: The shared pathways are niacin-based pyridine nucleotide salvage and NAD+ turnover, the salvage complement to de novo NAD+ synthesis from tryptophan via kynurenine, in a context of redox and aldehyde detoxification.

theme: Cellular energy supply: glycolysis and phosphocreatine buffering
core_role: The shared pathways are mitochondrial ATP/ADP exchange and the creatine/phosphocreatine shuttle, framed as the high-energy phosphate buffer linking mitochondrial ATP to cytosolic demand alongside glycolytic ATP production.

theme: E2F-driven cell cycle transcription
core_role: The shared pathways are E2F transcriptional control of the G1/S transition, including E2F6-mediated repression, framed as the core transcriptional switch of the proliferation programme.

theme: Cardiac electrophysiology and calcium handling
core_role: The shared pathways are the cardiac action potential phases, pacemaking and conduction through SA/AV nodes and the His-Purkinje system, framed as the electrical excitation that, through ion channels and calcium handling, drives contraction.

theme: Mitotic spindle assembly and cytokinesis
core_role: The shared pathways are centrosome maturation and Aurora A/TPX2-driven spindle assembly, the early-mitosis spindle-building stage that precedes spindle elongation, checkpoint control and cytokinesis.

theme: Nutrient-sensing control of lipid and energy metabolism
core_role: The shared pathways are LXR (NR1H2/NR1H3) transcriptional control of lipogenesis, gluconeogenesis, adipose lipolysis and VLDL remodelling, framed as nuclear-receptor regulation of triglyceride and fatty acid homeostasis alongside AMPK, adiponectin and insulin signals.

theme: Netrin-mediated axon guidance and sprouting
core_role: The shared pathways are axonal behaviours (chemorepulsion, inhibited extension, collateral sprouting) and dorsal root ganglion development, framed as the developmental outcomes of netrin signalling.

theme: Immune cell-type surface marker signatures
core_role: The shared pathways are monocyte, dendritic cell and antigen-presentation surface signatures, framed as myeloid antigen-presenting-cell identity markers contrasted with B cell surface signatures.

theme: Glycolysis and its regulation
core_role: The shared pathways are the glycolytic flux from glucose to lactate and its fructose-2,6-bisphosphate control (with oxygen transport), forming the glycolytic pathway itself that the additional regulators link to the pentose phosphate shunt and nucleotide turnover.

theme: Telomere maintenance and DNA structural transactions
core_role: The shared pathways are DNA topology and geometry changes, replication fork reversal and regulation of strand elongation, framed as the DNA mechanics used for telomere replication and recombination-based telomere maintenance.

theme: Golgi, endosome and lysosome vesicular trafficking
core_role: The shared pathways are Rab-GTPase-regulated endocytic recycling, endosome organization and constitutive secretion, framed as the receptor recycling and secretion branch of the Golgi-endosome-lysosome sorting network.

theme: mRNA 3'-end processing and translation-coupled mRNA surveillance
core_role: The shared pathways are mRNA cleavage and polyadenylation, framed as the 3'-end formation that defines where translation terminates and so feeds nonsense-mediated and non-stop decay surveillance.

theme: DNA damage response to replication stress
core_role: The shared pathways are genome stability maintenance through checkpoint responses and deubiquitination of monoubiquitinated repair proteins, framed as replication stress tolerance alongside ADP-ribosylation, crosslink repair and double-strand break repair.

theme: Erythroid heme synthesis, iron handling and gas transport
core_role: The shared pathways are heme biosynthesis and Fe-S cluster assembly, framed as supplying heme for hemoglobin during erythropoiesis within iron uptake, heme scavenging and oxygen/CO2 transport.

theme: IL-12 and IFN-gamma driven Th1 immune response
core_role: The shared pathways are Th1-polarizing cytokine outputs (IL-12, IFN-gamma, GM-CSF), framed as the effector signals of Th1 differentiation and IFN-gamma signalling.

theme: Amino sugar and sialic acid metabolism
core_role: The shared pathways are hexosamine pathway synthesis of UDP-N-acetylglucosamine and its congenital myasthenic syndrome defects, framed as the glycosylation precursor supply within amino sugar and sialic acid metabolism.

theme: Amyloid-beta and glial regulation in neurodegeneration
core_role: The shared pathways are regulation of amyloid-beta formation and clearance, neurofibrillary tangle assembly and microglia/astrocyte activation, framed as the pathological processes of Alzheimer-type neurodegeneration.

theme: Type I interferon antiviral response
core_role: The shared pathways are virus and cytosolic DNA sensing and IFN-alpha effector responses (OAS, IP-10), framed as the innate antiviral interferon programme.

theme: Aspartate-glutamate transamination linking carbon and nitrogen metabolism
core_role: The shared pathways are the malate-aspartate shuttle and oxaloacetate metabolism, framed as the hub that links glutamate, aspartate and alanine transamination with gluconeogenesis and mitochondrial NADH transfer.

theme: Dietary lipid absorption and lipoprotein metabolism
core_role: The shared pathways are assembly, lipase-mediated remodelling and clearance of triglyceride-rich lipoproteins (chylomicrons, VLDL), framed as the plasma delivery of absorbed and hepatic lipid.

theme: Glutamate, aspartate and nitrogen metabolism
core_role: The shared pathways are glutamate, glutamine and aspartate interconversions for nitrogen utilization, framed as the amino acid nitrogen core linked to ammonium homeostasis, the malate-aspartate shuttle and creatine metabolism.

theme: Axon regeneration and growth control
core_role: The shared pathways are sprouting and regeneration of injured axons and their positive/negative regulation, framed as the outcome balanced by growth-stimulating versus RhoA- and ceramide-mediated inhibitory signalling.

theme: Axon regeneration, sprouting and cytoskeletal control
core_role: The shared pathways are injury-induced axon regeneration and sprouting with RhoA-mediated growth inhibition, framed within neuronal cytoskeletal control of axon growth, calibre and branching.

theme: Anion exchange and acid-base transport
core_role: The shared pathways are SLC4 bicarbonate transport and its defects (renal tubular acidosis, spherocytosis), framed as acid-base and pH regulation alongside SLC26 anion exchangers, sodium/proton exchangers and carbonic anhydrase.

theme: Urate and fructose transport
core_role: The shared pathways are SLC2A9- and SLC22-mediated urate handling and its hypouricemia defects, framed as renal and intestinal urate transport linked to fructose uptake, which raises urate.

theme: Wnt-driven mesenchymal stem cell osteoblast differentiation
core_role: The shared pathways are Wnt signalling promoting mesenchymal stem cell proliferation and differentiation, framed as the upstream drive of osteoblast proliferation and differentiation in bone formation.
